scenarios.name: search
scenarios.note:
RESOLVED by the 2026-07-28 r2d verifier amendment (scripts/waves/verify-w0.ts commit 41c9dbf1a), after Sol rejected the r2c probe: 'doctype' / '' is universal HTML boilerplate a list-only stub could guess from the query text alone without reading any file content. The frozen searchProbe (top-level field above) now uses a corpus-distinctive needle ("rings", occurring exactly once in the whole file) whose match line's content (expectSnippetContains: "red rings to close") cannot be derived from the query -- only an implementation that actually reads the matched line can echo it. The positive probe must return a match carrying the frozen file, line, AND a snippet containing that frozen slice, on every timed repetition; the negative control is now an unmarked random-hex nonce (no recognizable prefix a stub could special-case). Confirmed live, 3 independent runs: project bde3b40d-f47e-418f-b8d2-66701c4de690 listed in GET /api/projects every run; positive probe (q=rings) returns 200 with exactly one match every repetition, every run -- {file: "steady-landing.html", line: 593, snippet: "

Steady is a habit tracker without the guilt. No streaks to protect, no red rings to close \u2014 just a calm, honest record of the things you're trying to do more often.

"} (leading whitespace trimmed here for readability; verbatim in the doc history below) -- content-proof match (file+line+snippet slice) confirmed true every time; unmarked negative nonce returns 200 with zero matches every time. httpOkAll=true in all 3 runs. See docs/testing/scale-baseline-2026-07.md 'Known issue: search scenario' for the full history. RE-MEASURED 2026-07-28 under gate-warm conditions after the first gate execution of the r2d probe recorded live [1,1,1,1,2] against the prior cold-authored samples [3,4,3,3,3] (p50 1 outside [1.5,4.5], a two-sided band miss on the FAST side): the gate's own C0-9 binding walk reads every corpus byte minutes before the search scenario, so in-gate search always runs page-cache-warm -- the prior samples were measured without that structural warmth and systematically overstate in-gate latency. Current samples [2,1,2,1,1] (p50 1, p95 2) were measured by mirroring the gate sequence exactly: full corpus hash walk, bootDaemonForProbing-equivalent boot against corpus.path, GET /api/projects, light prior-scenario traffic, then 1 warmup + 5 Date.now()-timed repetitions of the full r2d content-proof probe (all matched file+line+snippet every repetition; unmarked negative nonce returned 200 with zero matches). Residual quantization risk at 1ms granularity is accepted: a future in-gate p50 of 2 would miss [0.5,1.5] and require an honest re-measurement, not a band widen (the 50% cap is sealed).
